title: The Man with the Withered Hand
description: Jesus enters the synagogue on the Sabbath, where there is a man with a withered hand. The Pharisees watch him closely to see if he will heal on the Sabbath, so that they may accuse him. Jesus tells the man to stand up and come forward, and asks: "Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do evil, to save life or to kill?" But they remain silent. He looks around at them with anger, grieved by the hardness of their hearts, and says to the man: "Stretch out your hand." The man stretches it out, and his hand is restored. The Pharisees go out immediately and begin plotting with the Herodians how they may destroy him.
